title: Configuration instruction
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean symbols, let $\ell$ be a finite list of bit sources, let $T\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $i\in\mathbb{N}$. The instruction at position $i$ is determined by the configuration position assigned to $i$: for a cell position it selects the machine-state kind associated with that state and uses the padded cell sources; for an input position it selects the input kind and uses the padded input sources; and for a snapshot position it selects the snapshot kind and uses the padded snapshot sources.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine with Boolean symbols
$\ell$ is a finite list of bit sources
caveat: The configuration-position classification and the source-list constructions are opaque in the supplied material.
